result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers handle the record, bookmark, more-options and heart fixes well. Both keep the 'Favourite' name constant, expose the toggle state programmatically, and say not to also change the label. B wins narrowly on item 2: it gives the short 'Trim' (and 'Stop' as an option) and states outright that names must not include 'button' or 'icon'. A uses longer names and never states that rule. B loses some concision with its general-notes section and makes one odd claim, that 'the role is also missing from the name'. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers give the right names for the record, bookmark and overflow controls. Both fix the heart with one constant name plus a programmatic toggle state. B says outright not to combine a changing label with a toggle state. A wrongly says the role is 'missing from the name' for the stop control, which contradicts its own advice, offers two names for that control, and adds a general-notes section that drifts into a broader lecture. A does state the rule against putting 'button' or 'icon' in a name more clearly, but B is cleaner overall, though 'Stop recording' and 'Trim recording' are longer than needed.
